title: 第1038章 天龟肆虐第1037章 剧毒丝线和化灵之火
slug: 聚宝仙锅第1038章天龟肆虐
content_zh:
化灵之火？
没错，李凡还是第一次听说，火焰还可以消化修士的血肉，而不是将修士的尸体化成灰烬。
这什么化灵之火有点意思！
可是，李凡刚刚有了一点贪念，小灵却泼了一盆冷水，说以李凡现在的能力，简直是痴心妄想！
没办法，李凡只好转移注意力，放在天魂珠上。
可是，下面小灵的话，让李凡直接跳脚，“天魂珠，在这庞然大物的头颅里？
不是，小灵，咱们费劲巴拉的来到胃部空间，你现在又说是在头颅里。
难道，以我的实力，还能将这神兽天龟残魂灭杀吗？”
“不，不！”
小灵小脑袋摇成拨浪鼓，“不用咱们出手哦！”
话音未落！
轰，轰！
两个惊天动地的声音。
随即，李凡感觉整个神兽天龟残魂的庞大身躯，在剧烈的颤抖。
这声音，李凡还算熟悉，应该是斗法爆裂声。
只是，这可不是普通规模的斗法。
甚至呢，金丹后期，或者假婴期，都根本无法造成这种恐怖的爆裂声。
那么，施法的修士呼之欲出！
元婴期！
这次，可不是元婴期实力，比如李凡遇到的少妇那种取巧方式达到元婴期的情况。

这一次，是实实在在的元婴期老怪物在施展法术。
元婴期，寿元足足可以达到一千岁！
所以，在低级修士口中，才会称呼为元婴期老怪物。
据说，元婴期老怪物都有毁山断河的恐怖实力。
这一点，李凡到目前为止，还没有亲身体会过。
只有一次，李凡利用上品瞬移符咒和百变魔功，成功从元婴期老怪物的眼皮底下逃脱。
其实，回想起来，李凡上一次能够在元婴期老怪物眼皮底下逃脱，也有一定的运气。
首先，是李凡的果决，他根本不等对方有所反应，立刻开启了极品瞬移符咒。
其次，当时的元婴期老怪物也有一定的大意，似乎感觉李凡是老鼠遇到猫，根本不可能逃走。
说回当下。
李凡通过爆裂声音的不同，判断出来，这次出手的可不止是一个元婴期老怪物。
至少是两位！
content_en:
Spiritual fire?
That's right, this was the first time Li Fan heard that flames could digest the flesh and blood of monks instead of turning their bodies into ashes.
This spirit-transforming fire is interesting!
However, just when Li Fan was a little greedy, Xiao Ling poured cold water on him, saying that with Li Fan's current ability, it was simply wishful thinking!
There was no other way, so Li Fan had no choice but to divert his attention to the Heavenly Soul Pearl.
However, Xiao Ling's words below made Li Fan immediately jump to his feet, "The Heavenly Soul Pearl is in the head of this behemoth?
No, Xiaoling, we worked hard to get to the stomach space, and now you said it was in the head.
Could it be that, with my strength, I can still kill the remaining soul of this divine beast, the turtle? "
"No, no!"
Xiao Ling shook her little head like a rattle, "We don't need to take action!"
The words have not yet been spoken!
Boom, boom!
Two earth-shattering voices.
Immediately, Li Fan felt that the entire huge body of the remnant soul of the divine beast Sky Turtle was trembling violently.
This sound was quite familiar to Li Fan. It should be the sound of a fighting burst.
However, this is no ordinary-scale battle.
Even in the late stage of the golden elixir or the false baby stage, it is impossible to cause such a terrifying explosion.
Then, the monk who casts the spell is ready to come out!
Nascent Soul stage!
This time, it is not the strength of the Nascent Soul stage, such as the young woman Li Fan met who reached the Nascent Soul stage in a tricky way.
This time, it was a real old monster in the Nascent Soul stage who was casting spells.
In the Nascent Soul stage, one can live up to a thousand years!
Therefore, among low-level monks, they are called old monsters in the Nascent Soul stage.
It is said that old monsters in the Nascent Soul stage have the terrifying power to destroy mountains and rivers.
Li Fan has not experienced this personally so far.
Only once did Li Fan successfully escape from under the eyes of an old monster in the Nascent Soul stage by using high-grade teleportation spells and versatile magic skills.
In fact, looking back, Li Fan had some luck when he was able to escape under the nose of the old monster in the Nascent Soul stage last time.
First of all, it was Li Fan's decisiveness. He didn't wait for the other party to react and immediately activated the ultimate teleportation spell.
Secondly, the old monster in the Nascent Soul stage at that time was also careless. It seemed that Li Fan was like a mouse meeting a cat and it was impossible to escape.
Back to the present.
Li Fan judged from the difference in the explosion sounds that it was not just an old monster in the Nascent Soul stage who was attacking this time.
At least two!
